name: Onboarding — signed up, never joined a round
description: A new user who created a profile and has not joined any round. Two nudges only: after one day, then after three more. Anyone who joins leaves through the `did` port and is never messaged. The day-one nudge is skipped entirely for users who already set availability, and is delivered in-app rather than by push for users who never granted notification permission — day one is exactly when that permission is least likely to exist.

config._note: The first moment a person is identifiable. The install itself is anonymous and has no event.
A full day without joining a round. `did` means they found a game on their own — nothing to push.

Skips the availability push for anyone who already set it. Telling someone to do a thing they have already done is the fastest way to teach them our notifications are not worth reading. `yes` jumps straight to the second wait: availability is not their blocker, so the open-games nudge is the one that can still help.

Day one is the WORST moment for push reach: the permission prompt has barely been seen, so a large slice of this audience is unreachable by push and would silently receive nothing. push_permission is one of the five attributes the app actually sends, so the branch is free. `no` delivers the same message in-app — the one channel that still reaches them.
Asks for AVAILABILITY, not for a game. Someone who did not join on day one usually found nothing that fit; pointing them back at the same list repeats what already failed.
config.title: בוא נמצא לך משחק 👟
config.body: סמן באילו ימים אתה פנוי, ונודיע לך כשנפתח מחזור שמתאים לך.

config._note: HTML rather than native so the card can carry the pitch header and read as part of the product. Needs Teamder 1.0.99+, which is the build that added the HTML in-app renderer and declares content.html — older installs report they cannot draw it and are simply not targeted.

customContent.html:
⚽

רגע לפני שאתה יוצא למגרש

מתי נוח לך לשחק?

סמן את הימים והשעות שאתה פנוי, ונודיע לך ברגע שנפתח מחזור שמתאים בדיוק לך — בלי לחפש, בלי לפספס.

סימון זמינות ←

לוקח פחות מדקה · אפשר לשנות בכל רגע

config._note: Three more days. The journey ends after the second push — a third nudge to someone who has not played is pursuit, not onboarding.
Removes the real blocker, which is social rather than logistical: you need neither a club nor to know anyone.
config.title: יש מחזורים פתוחים לידך
config.body: לא צריך מועדון ולא צריך להכיר אף אחד — נכנסים למחזור פתוח ומשחקים.
